summary.zh-CN: 修复 Linux runner 的系统兼容、缺失 Runtime 自愈和子进程异常导致宿主 502 的问题。
summary.en-US: Fix Linux runner compatibility, incomplete Runtime self-repair, and host 502 errors caused by runner failures.

title.zh-CN: Linux 可移植应用正常启动
title.en-US: Portable Apps start on more Linux systems

body.zh-CN: Linux x64 runner 改为静态链接，不再要求服务器提供构建环境中的新版 glibc。
body.en-US: The Linux x64 runner is statically linked and no longer requires the newer glibc version from the build environment.

body.zh-CN: 缺少 runner 时会下载签名的完整 Runtime；runner 启动失败会返回结构化错误，不再带崩 NextClaw 主服务。
body.en-US: A missing runner triggers a signed Runtime download, while runner startup failures return a structured error instead of terminating the NextClaw host.
